title: Speech Secrets - Videos
description:
Sharing my speech therapy secrets! Home therapy tips, education, and exercises for individuals with neurologic injuries and their caregivers. I'm Kasondra, a speech therapist in California working with clients who have aphasia, dysarthria, dysphagia, voice and cognitive difficulties from acquired neurologic conditions.  

This channel provides general information for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor or speech-language pathologist before trying any exercises. You do these exercises at your own risk. For help finding a certified speech therapist near you, visit asha.org/profind.

Due to legal and ethical reasons, I cannot answer questions about individual medical or therapy needs. Thanks for understanding!
